name: 13_pokemon_lookalikes
sql:
WITH views AS (
  SELECT e.user_id, i.c1_id, i.brand_id
  FROM merrec_events e JOIN merrec_items i ON i.item_id = e.item_id
  WHERE e.event_type = 'item_view' AND e.event_time < TIMESTAMP '2023-09-01 00:00:00'
), dims AS (
  SELECT c1_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY n DESC, c1_id) - 1 AS dim
  FROM (SELECT c1_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM views GROUP BY c1_id) c
  ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 64
), counts AS (
  SELECT v.user_id, d.dim, COUNT(*) AS n FROM views v JOIN dims d ON d.c1_id = v.c1_id GROUP BY v.user_id, d.dim
), totals AS (
  SELECT user_id, SUM(n) AS total FROM counts GROUP BY user_id HAVING SUM(n) >= 20
), taste AS (
  SELECT c.user_id AS id,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 0 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d0,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 1 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d1,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 2 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d2,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 3 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d3,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 4 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d4,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 5 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d5,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 6 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d6,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 7 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d7,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 8 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d8,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 9 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d9,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 10 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d10,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 11 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d11,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 12 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d12,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 13 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d13,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 14 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d14,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 15 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d15,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 16 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d16,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 17 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d17,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 18 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d18,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 19 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d19,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 20 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d20,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 21 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d21,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 22 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d22,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 23 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d23,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 24 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d24,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 25 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d25,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 26 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d26,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 27 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d27,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 28 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d28,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 29 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d29,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 30 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d30,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 31 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d31,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 32 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d32,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 33 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d33,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 34 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d34,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 35 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d35,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 36 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d36,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 37 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d37,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 38 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d38,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 39 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d39,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 40 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d40,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 41 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d41,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 42 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d42,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 43 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d43,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 44 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d44,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 45 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d45,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 46 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d46,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 47 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d47,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 48 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d48,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 49 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d49,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 50 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d50,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 51 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d51,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 52 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d52,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 53 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d53,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 54 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d54,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 55 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d55,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 56 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d56,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 57 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d57,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 58 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d58,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 59 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d59,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 60 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d60,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 61 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d61,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 62 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d62,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 63 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d63
  FROM counts c JOIN totals t ON t.user_id = c.user_id
  GROUP BY c.user_id, t.total
), pokemon_buys AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.user_id, CASE WHEN e.event_time >= TIMESTAMP '2023-09-01 00:00:00' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS later
  FROM merrec_events e JOIN merrec_items i ON i.item_id = e.item_id
  WHERE e.event_type = 'buy_comp' AND i.brand_id = 17470 AND e.event_time >= TIMESTAMP '2023-07-01 00:00:00'
), seed AS (
  SELECT t.id FROM taste t JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM pokemon_buys WHERE later = 0) b ON b.user_id = t.id
), candidates AS (
  SELECT t.* FROM taste t LEFT JOIN seed s ON s.id = t.id WHERE s.id IS NULL
), lookalikes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT neighbor_id AS id
  FROM cuvs_brute_force_knn(
    dataset => (SELECT * FROM candidates ORDER BY id),
    queries => (SELECT t.* FROM taste t JOIN seed s ON s.id = t.id ORDER BY t.id),
    k => 20, metric => 'l2_expanded')
), pokemon_viewers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id AS id FROM views WHERE brand_id = 17470
), later_buyers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id AS id FROM pokemon_buys WHERE later = 1
), audiences AS (
  SELECT 'lookalikes' AS audience, l.id FROM lookalikes l
  UNION ALL SELECT 'pokemon viewers', c.id FROM candidates c JOIN pokemon_viewers v ON v.id = c.id
  UNION ALL SELECT 'all active shoppers', c.id FROM candidates c
)
SELECT a.audience, COUNT(*) AS shoppers, COUNT(b.id) AS buyers_sep_oct,
       CAST(COUNT(b.id) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) AS purchase_rate
FROM audiences a LEFT JOIN later_buyers b ON b.id = a.id
GROUP BY a.audience
ORDER BY purchase_rate DESC;
